raddle.definition:
v. twist or braid together, interlace
v. mark or paint with raddle
raddle.translation:
n. 代赭石, 编篱笆用的细枝条
vt. 涂红赭色, 涂胭脂色, 把...交织, 编篱笆

raddled.definition: s. used until no longer useful
raddled.translation: a. 混乱的, 坏掉的

raddles.definition:
n. a red iron ore used in dyeing and marking
v. twist or braid together, interlace
v. mark or paint with raddle
raddles.translation:
n. 赭石（等于ruddle）
vt. 涂红赭色；交织

raddling.definition:
v. twist or braid together, interlace
v. mark or paint with raddle
raddling.translation:
n. 赭石（等于ruddle）
vt. 涂红赭色；交织

raddol.translation: abbr. raddolcendo (Italian=growing calmer) （意大利语）变得更平静
